title: Carrageenan: FDA GRAS Status, IARC Classification & Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on carrageenan (E407), covering FDA GRAS status under 21 CFR 172.620, the critical distinction between food-grade carrageenan and degraded carrageenan (poligeenan), IARC classification, NOSB organic delisting controversy, and EFSA re-evaluation.
seo_title: Carrageenan Regulatory Status 2026 | FDA, IARC, EU & Organic Standards | Policy Canary
seo_description: Carrageenan remains FDA GRAS (21 CFR 172.620). IARC Group 2B applies only to degraded carrageenan (poligeenan), not food-grade. NOSB voted to remove from organic but USDA overruled. EU re-evaluation ongoing. No US bans.
